mae (arch): quick heads-up — we saw a burst of cold starts in staging during the canary sweep. looks like alias flips are causing mass evicts. proposing lightweight rollout metadata to reduce blast radius.
kai (infra): ok sketch the fields. is this solver-side or runtime?
mae (arch): control-plane writes + runtime currently unbinds immediately. fields: stability_window_ms, evict_grace_ms, alias_mode (hard|soft|sticky), client_probe_hint, expected_dual_serve, tenant_eviction_opt_out. default alias_mode=hard for backcompat.
ravi (runtime): runtime plan: maintain lease state per alias: ACTIVE -> PENDING_DEFERRED_EVICT -> STALE. on flip mark previous as PENDING_DEFERRED_EVICT; background reconcile promotes to HARD_EVICT after evict_grace_ms AND low traffic. tenant explicit pins always override metadata.
nana (product): UX: during grace window some traffic may hit old variant. we should surface expected_dual_serve in console and docs. recommend default false for immediate switches, true for staged rollouts.
ben (sre): telemetry needed: alias_transition_count, deferred_eviction_seconds, dual_serve_ratio, pin_override_count. alert if deferred_eviction > configured SLO and error rates increase.
kai (infra): backwards compat: new fields ignored by older runtimes. gate soft semantics behind a cluster feature-flag and rollout in canaries first. add migration playbook.
ravi (runtime): test plan: simulate flip storm (50 flips / 5m) and assert cold-start rate <= 1.5x baseline. unit tests for lease transitions and reconciler.
ops-bot: created TKT-2026-900: "alias lifecycle metrics + migration playbook" assigned to ravi.
mae (arch): decision: prototype soft alias_mode + stability_window in staging behind FF. owners: ravi(runtime), kai(infra), ana(product), ben(sre). follow-up: RFC for alias lifecycle with schema, telemetry, and console copy.
